# Sling: a forked wooden slingshot 0.46 m tall with a khaki band between its prongs. Grip at the origin.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Grip --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.040
scale 0.080 0.080 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name ProngR --size 1 --location -0.070 0.000 0.240
scale 0.070 0.070 0.240
apply --scale
material assign Wood
set rotation 0 -20 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name ProngL --size 1 --location 0.070 0.000 0.240
scale 0.070 0.070 0.240
apply --scale
material assign Wood
set rotation 0 20 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Band --size 1 --location 0.000 0.020 0.330
scale 0.280 0.050 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Band
select all
shade flat
export sling.glb
